The '''''Audacity''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that saw action during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it was still active (albeit badly damaged) by [[Tag Rogaren]], who encountered [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in the ruined remains of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and gave her permission to board.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars (2013) 8|''Star Wars'' (2013) 8]] and [[Star Wars (2013) 9|''Star Wars'' (2013) 9]], the ship is referred to as the ''Audacity''. However, in narrative text and dialogue in [[Star Wars (2013) 10|''Star Wars'' (2013) 10]], the ship is called the "decommissioned ''Resolute''," a name shared with [[Resolute/Legends|another ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] from the Clone Wars that was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The dialogue in ''Star Wars 10'' is assumed to be an error given the previous issues' distinction of the ship as the ''Audacity''.
